title: Mindcrack SMP Modpack
description: This is a pack of mods used by the members of the Mindcrack SMP server.
body:
This is a simple modpack used by the Mindcrack group on the Mindcrack SMP server. It contains all mods that are on the server and some client-side performance mods.  A great starting point for anyone playing ON the Mindcrack server or wanting to emulate the experience of their favorite content creator.


Mods included in this pack:
- Simple Voice Chat
- Sit!
- No Chat Reports
- Flashback
- Emotecraft
- Distant Horizons
- Chat Heads
- Facebar
- Armor Stands
- Player Animation Library


Performance mods:
- Lithium
- Sodium
